claim: The workspace contains CS2_36, NASA PCoE, and Oxford data usable for discharge-curve validation.
A Latin-hypercube multi-parameter ECAT-inspired search space was generated and used to train an ANN surrogate.
The ANN surrogate accurately approximates the reduced-order simulator over voltage, thermal, and capacity outputs.
The GA-style ANN-assisted search improves the training objective relative to an LHS-only random search baseline.
Identified internal parameters are reported with bounds and units.
External validation was evaluated on NASA and Oxford where available, but this is approximate because no full ECAT simulator is provided.
